hints.title: What ends at each position?
hints.body: For each position, consider the best sum of a stretch that ends exactly there.

hints.title: Extend or restart
hints.body: The best stretch ending at `i` is either the previous best plus `nums[i]`, or `nums[i]` alone.

hints.title: Keep a running best
hints.body: Track the best ending sum and the best answer seen so far in one pass.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
ending = nums[0]
best = nums[0]
for value in nums[1:]:
    ending = max(value, ending + value)
    best = max(best, ending)
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
